meaning_mizo: A vun hring a, a chak deuh, mihring tinin ei duh ngat rah thei.

english_gloss: pear
meaning_mizo: A pum chak deuh a, a nal chuan a tui, tuikhal tam rah thei.
example_mizo: Kawlthei nal ei chu a tui hle.

meaning_mizo: A rah sên dum a, ṭhah pahnihin an chuang thin rah chi.
example_mizo: Anhling nal hi a rah dum vek a, a tui hle.

english_gloss: enemy territory, hostile foreign land
meaning_mizo: Ral emaw hriatsa lo mite awmna ram.

example_mizo: Anih chu thing hâr ang a nih avangin buaina eng emawah pawh a tlan ngai lo.

english_gloss: fortunate, blessed (idiom, lit. "carrying a blessing")
meaning_mizo: Hlawhtling zâwk leh malsawmna hmu zâwk mi sawina.
example_mizo: Anih chu thupha chawi a nih avangin a thil tum apiang a hlawhtling thin.

meaning_mizo: Buh emaw ba emaw phun tur atan sak thar tak lo.
example_mizo: Kan pa chu losûl atangin a lo haw tawh.

notes: Source: Kumtluang Class VI (SCERT Mizoram). VERIFY: meaning inferred from context (listed among undesirable youthful behaviors); precise dictionary definition not confirmed.
english_gloss: rowdy or mischievous behavior, especially among young men
meaning_mizo: Tlangvalte chungah lo hmuh theih inbuainan emaw suahsualnain emaw.
example_mizo: Tlangvalho pawhraw avangin khaw mipuiin an duh lo.

notes: Source: Kumtluang Class VI (SCERT Mizoram). VERIFY: word-box vocabulary item without an explicit dictionary definition given in the book; gloss inferred from context.

meaning_mizo: Mi dang nen inbântlang theih a chak leh a thiam dan lam ah.

english_gloss: mutual conflict, feud, or armed clash between groups
meaning_mizo: Pawl pahnih emaw hnam pahnih inkara indoh nasa tak.
example_mizo: Hmanlai khan khaw pahnih inkarah inkulh a lo awm thin.

english_gloss: good conduct, good behavior
meaning_mizo: Nunphung leh chetna ṭha, mi zahawmna hmuh theih.
example_mizo: Naupang chu kam tha avangin sikulah an hria bik.

english_gloss: worthy, deserving, qualified
meaning_mizo: Hna emaw thuneihna emaw dawng tura inhman theih tak mi emaw thil.
example_mizo: Anih hi hruaitu nih chungtlak tak a ni.

english_gloss: a companion who travels or spends time with one
meaning_mizo: Kawng kalpuiin emaw thil tihpuiin emaw awmpui zêl mi.
example_mizo: Ka lenrual an nih avangin ka hlau tawh lo.

english_gloss: poor, destitute, bare
meaning_mizo: Sum leh pai emaw thil nei tlem tak, retheihna avanga awm bawrhbawr dan.
example_mizo: Riang mite kan ṭanpui tur a ni.

english_gloss: to wither, fade
meaning_mizo: Par emaw hnah emaw a mawina bo ta a, a chhe leh dan.
example_mizo: Par mawi tak te pawh hun chhung chuan an chul zêl thin.

english_gloss: to sprout, bloom, germinate
meaning_mizo: Par emaw thal emaw a chhuah hmasa berah lo pian dan.
example_mizo: Ruah a sur hnuah thlai te an vul chhuak ta.

notes: Source: Kumtluang Class VI (SCERT Mizoram). VERIFY: exact idiomatic nuance uncertain; drawn from a single line of poetry without a direct dictionary gloss.
english_gloss: to journey or spread across hills and land (poetic phrase)
meaning_mizo: Tlang leh mual chhung zawng zawng a zâwn/kal dan sawina.
example_mizo: Kan hla thu-ah kan tuikhawhthlak ram chu mual liam tuma an ti thin.

english_gloss: a close companion who has helped/supported one since childhood
meaning_mizo: Naupan atanga inṭanpui zêl, inhnaih tak mi.
example_mizo: Kan ṭhian hi ka ai hnah phahpui a ni, kan innei ṭha hle.

english_gloss: to be constantly busy or occupied without rest (idiom)
meaning_mizo: Thil tam takah ngirhtawn lovin inchuh zêl dan sawina.
example_mizo: Sikul kaihhruaitu chu hnathawh avangin phûng zinga piring vawrh ang a ni thin.

english_gloss: trouble, problem, disturbance
meaning_mizo: Harsatna emaw inrelbawlna har tak awm dan.
example_mizo: Buaina hlauhawm tak an lo awm a.

english_gloss: mistake, fault, wrongdoing
meaning_mizo: Thil dik lo tih emaw suala thawk dan.
example_mizo: Balhna kan neih chuan kan puang phah tlat a ni.

english_gloss: mutual teasing or playful pranking between children
meaning_mizo: Naupangte inkara insakawihna emaw indawtna.
example_mizo: Naupangho chu inhnawk avangin an nui vak vak.

english_gloss: to poke or pester one another playfully
meaning_mizo: Mi pahnih emaw tam takin an inhriatpui a, in inkalh a in nulh dan.
example_mizo: Unaute chu an kalh nulh avangin an nui riau riau a.

english_gloss: mockery, ridicule
meaning_mizo: Mi emaw thil emaw nuihzatin thliar hriat dan.
example_mizo: A nuihsawh loh chungin naupang chu ṭanpui a ngai zâwk.

english_gloss: to nag, pester, or incite someone with words
meaning_mizo: Thu leh hla hmangin mi fak emaw sawi emaw hriat dan.
example_mizo: Amah chu a unaute chuan an fuihpawrh thin.

english_gloss: a certain female relative (kinship term, roughly "sister-in-law" or female cousin)
meaning_mizo: Mipa aiin, a unaute zinga hmeichhia hi a farnu an ti.
example_mizo: Ka farnu chu vawiin kan in ah a rawn tlawh.

notes: Source: Kumtluang Class VI (SCERT Mizoram). VERIFY culture-sensitive: a traditional waist-pouch that was part of everyday men's dress; route to human culture reviewer if needed.
english_gloss: a small pouch tied at the waist to carry small items
meaning_mizo: In hnuaia kaldung te leh thil tê tê chelh nan kawrah bân thin ip tê.
example_mizo: Hmanlai mipain thawmmâwl an bân thin a, chutah chelhte an dah thin.

notes: Source: Kumtluang Class VI (SCERT Mizoram). VERIFY culture-sensitive: a traditional carrying-strap item; route to human culture reviewer if needed.
english_gloss: a cord or strap for slinging a bundle over the shoulder
meaning_mizo: Puan emaw thil pawh chu phak lama zâr theih nana hrui thlun.
example_mizo: A puanpuih chu tlangbân hmangin a phak.

notes: Source: Kumtluang Class VI (SCERT Mizoram). VERIFY culture-sensitive: a traditional headgear/attire item; route to human culture reviewer if needed.
english_gloss: a plain-brimmed traditional woven hat
meaning_mizo: Khumpui chi pakhat, a piah lam a bâng sang lo va bial mai.
example_mizo: Hmanlai mipain banglai an khum thin.

english_gloss: a bamboo hat woven with an even, well-matched pattern
meaning_mizo: Bang (khumpui) chi khat a chhuan dan a kim tak leh a rem tak lo siam.
example_mizo: Chu khumpui chu bang kalh kim tak a ni, a chhuan a ṭha em em.

meaning_mizo: Zu (buh atanga siam dawtharh) dahna leh chawihna hmang bêl emaw thawmhnaw.
example_mizo: Hmanlai khan zufâng chu zu chelhna atan an hmang thin.

meaning_mizo: Mitthi chhinchhiahna nana thil siam emaw hman dan.

english_gloss: a mithun skull displayed as part of a memorial or grave-marking custom
meaning_mizo: Mitthi chhinchhiahna leh lungphun huna sial lu an târ, chu chu a ni.
example_mizo: Hmanlai khan lal thih hunah se hrân lu an târ thin.

notes: Source: Kumtluang Class VI (SCERT Mizoram). VERIFY culture-sensitive: a traditional attire/craft ornament; route to human culture reviewer if needed.
english_gloss: a decorative pin or peg on a traditional headdress
meaning_mizo: Khumpui lu lamah dah, thil dah theih tur ang maiin siam ban.
example_mizo: A khumpui chungah tungchaw ṭha tak a dah.

meaning_mizo: Thlangpui hmangin siam, thil phurh emaw kâwl nan hman theih ip.

english_gloss: a flat woven bamboo winnowing tray
meaning_mizo: Buh thlak nan hman, thlangpui hmangin siam ip bial.
example_mizo: Thlangrâ hmangin buh a chi leh a hnah a then thin.

notes: Source: Kumtluang Class VI (SCERT Mizoram). VERIFY culture-sensitive: a traditional bamboo-craft item; route to human culture reviewer if needed. VERIFY possible duplicate: diacritic-variant of existing word 'arbawm' already in corpus — confirm same word or distinct before import.

meaning_mizo: Thlangpui hmangin siam, ar emaw ran te khum nan hman ip.

english_gloss: a large woven basket used to store seed rice
meaning_mizo: Buh chi tuh atan dah, thlangpui hmangin siam ip lian.
example_mizo: Buh chi chu paipêr chhungah an dah khum.

notes: Source: Kumtluang Class VI (SCERT Mizoram). VERIFY culture-sensitive: a traditional bamboo-craft tool; route to human culture reviewer if needed. VERIFY: given in the book as an alternate/regional name for the sifting tool "chhihri"; usage confirmed only from that one gloss.
english_gloss: a bamboo sifting tool (alternate name for chhihri)
meaning_mizo: Chhihri tih ang bawkin buhkem thenna atan hman ip.
example_mizo: Buh a kem chuan vaihrik hmangin a thenpui thin.

notes: Source: Kumtluang Class VI (SCERT Mizoram). VERIFY culture-sensitive: a traditional household craft item; route to human culture reviewer if needed.
english_gloss: a hanging bamboo rack placed near the fireplace for storage
meaning_mizo: Meichhâwl lam chhung dawnah thil dah tur siam, thlangpui hmangin siam.
example_mizo: A thawmhnaw chu lamthlûk chungah a dah zung zung thin.

english_gloss: the sole or heel of the foot
meaning_mizo: Mihring ke thla, lei kan chantir bul lam.
example_mizo: Kawng rei tak a kal avangin a hniak a na hle.

english_gloss: a state of shock, daze, or stupor from fear or a sudden mishap
meaning_mizo: Hlauhna emaw thil mak thleng avanga eng mah hriat theih lo dan.
example_mizo: Accident a hmuh avangin a thidang vek a, a ṭawngkam a chhuah thei ta lo.

english_gloss: a large knife or machete (synonym of "chempui")
meaning_mizo: Chem lian tak, thing phawh emaw ram siam nan hman.
example_mizo: A pa chuan chemtum hmangin thing a phawh.

english_gloss: a wide-mouthed clay pot or jar
meaning_mizo: Lei hmangin siam bêl chi, a mawng a chhuan.
example_mizo: Zu emaw tui emaw dah nan belmang an hman thin.

english_gloss: human scent or trace
meaning_mizo: Mihring zâwnna emaw a awmna hriat theihna rim.
example_mizo: Ui chuan hlâng a hnâm chhuak a, kan awmna a hre ve.

english_gloss: a formal application or request (letter)
meaning_mizo: Thil emaw phal atan ngenna ziah.
example_mizo: Sikul hall hman phalna dilna ka ziak.

english_gloss: a formal invitation
meaning_mizo: Hun pawimawhah kal tura ko a, ziah thin lehkha.
example_mizo: Ka birthday atan sawmna ka thawn.

english_gloss: an authority or official who has decision-making power
meaning_mizo: Thu neitu emaw phalna pe theitu.
example_mizo: Kan hna dilna hi thuneitu hnenah kan thawn.

english_gloss: secret, hidden matter
meaning_mizo: Mi tam takin hriat lo, thup taka awm thu.
example_mizo: Chu thu chu thuhrûk a nih avangin tu hnenah pawh a sawi lo.
